data.title: Stock Picks: Cnergenz And Northeast Group
data.description:
RHB Investment Bank Bhd (RHB Research) sees further upside potential in Cnergenz Bhd and Northeast Group Bhd following recent bullish price movements, with both counters showing signs of renewed buying interest.

For Cnergenz, RHB Research said the stock could resume its upward movement after rebounding sharply from its recent low. The counter formed a long bullish candlestick on higher trading volume yesterday and was testing its immediate resistance at RM1.05.

A decisive close above this level would confirm the bullish setup, potentially sending the stock towards RM1.12, followed by RM1.18. However, a fall below the RM1 support would invalidate the rebound and expose the counter to further correction.

Meanwhile, Northeast Group has staged a strong recovery after bouncing off its interim support. The stock formed a Bullish Marubozu candlestick yesterday and closed at its daily high above the RM0.94 resistance, indicating renewed buying momentum.

RHB Research noted that the counter remains below its 21-day simple moving average (SMA), with a move above the line expected to strengthen its bullish outlook.

Following the breakout above RM0.94, Northeast Group could test RM1.02, followed by RM1.10. A decline below the RM0.86 support, however, would negate the bullish setup and signal a resumption of its correction phase.

data.title: Take-Two Shares Surge Over 8% As GTA VI Reviews Fuel Sales Optimism
data.description:
Shares of Take-Two Interactive surged more than 8% on Wednesday as positive early reviews of “Grand Theft Auto VI” boosted investor confidence in the blockbuster game’s sales potential and the publisher’s revenue outlook.

The stock was the top gainer on the Nasdaq-100 index, recovering from a 19% decline year-to-date through Tuesday’s close, as players and critics gave the latest instalment in the franchise an early score of 99 on review aggregator Metacritic.

The game, which follows more than 13 years after its predecessor, has generated intense anticipation, with some players reportedly taking several days of leave and making arrangements with partners to secure uninterrupted gaming time.

Nick McKay, senior analyst for video gaming and digital entertainment at Freedom Capital Markets, said the strong Metacritic score had addressed concerns over whether the game could meet expectations.

“The wait appears to have been worth it for gamers and investors alike,” he said.

Analysts at Wells Fargo raised their estimates for GTA VI sales to about 65 million units in Take-Two’s current financial year ending March, up from their previous projection of 35 million units.

The revised forecast also factors in the possibility of a PC release in early 2027.

Reuters

The brokerage lifted its annual bookings forecast for Take-Two by 19% to US$9.76 billion, above the LSEG consensus estimate of US$8 billion and the company’s own guidance of between US$8 billion and US$8.20 billion.

Oppenheimer separately estimated that GTA VI could generate about US$1.85 billion in gross revenue during its first three days, compared with the US$1 billion recorded by predecessor GTA V following its 2013 release.

The game’s launch is also expected to benefit the wider gaming industry, with research firm Newzoo forecasting 3% growth in the global console player base in 2026, compared with a likely decline without the release.

“Few releases can change how the whole console market spends, and GTA VI is one of those rare titles,” said Emmanuel Rosier, Newzoo’s director of market intelligence.

Beyond gaming, the launch could also drive activity across other digital platforms and consumer services.

Analytics firm Sensor Tower estimated that the release could generate more than 50 million additional visits to food delivery and restaurant applications in the United States within 30 days, as players spend extended periods gaming.

Social media platforms such as YouTube and Reddit are also expected to see increased engagement as fans discuss the game and share gameplay clips.

Shares of DoorDash rose 2%, while Reddit edged marginally higher.

As of noon Eastern Time on Wednesday, about 17.1 million units of GTA VI had been sold, according to a Sensor Tower tracker, exceeding pre-order volumes for major game releases in recent history.

data.title: HSIF Heads Towards 23,000-Point Floor, RHB Holds Its Shorts
data.description:
RHB Investment Bank Bhd (RHB Research) is maintaining its short positions on the Hang Seng Index Futures (HSIF), with the index approaching the 23,000-point support level following a second consecutive session of losses.

The HSIF fell 264 points to close at 23,226 points on Wednesday, after opening at 23,480 points and reaching an intraday high of 23,540 points. Selling pressure subsequently pushed it to a low of 23,202 points, leaving it near the bottom of its trading range.

In evening trading, the index shed another 126 points to last trade at 23,100 points.

RHB Research said the bearish candlestick formation indicated that sellers remained firmly in control, with the index continuing to trade below both its 20-day and 50-day simple moving average (SMA) lines.

The relative strength index (RSI) also continued to fall below the 50% level, reinforcing the bearish technical outlook.

The research house said a break below the immediate support at 23,000 points could expose the index to further downside towards 22,500 points.

It maintained its negative trading bias as long as the HSIF remained below the stop-loss threshold of 24,500 points.

RHB Research advised traders to retain short positions initiated at the Nov 13 closing level of 23,576 points, with the stop-loss level unchanged at 24,500 points.

The first resistance is pegged at 24,000 points, followed by the higher resistance at 24,500 points.

data.title: Wall Street Ends Mixed As Investors Weigh Nvidia Results, Hawkish Fed Minutes
data.description:
Wall Street ended mixed on Wednesday as investors assessed Nvidia’s latest earnings, awaited the pricing of artificial intelligence company Anthropic’s initial public offering (IPO) and digested minutes from the US Federal Reserve’s October policy meeting, which pointed to the possibility of further interest rate hikes.

After fluctuating early in the session, the Nasdaq Composite closed higher, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell sharply. The S&P 500 also reversed earlier gains to finish in negative territory following the release of the Fed minutes.

According to preliminary data, the S&P 500 fell 18 points, or 0.24%, to 7,322.53, while the Nasdaq Composite gained 101.50 points, or 0.39%, to 24,429.89. The Dow dropped 566.39 points, or 1.12%, to 50,193.03.

Nvidia shares declined despite the chipmaker reporting quarterly results above analyst expectations and forecasting fourth-quarter revenue ahead of estimates. Investor uncertainty was compounded by the sudden departure of co-founder Jensen Huang last week.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index also closed slightly lower, reflecting concerns over elevated expectations for the sector amid substantial spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure and risks associated with the emerging technology.

Other chipmakers traded mixed, with Intel and Micron losing ground while Advanced Micro Devices advanced.

“There’s been a lot of dark clouds of uncertainty over technology, chip stocks and AI in general,” said Ryan Detrick, chief market strategist at Carson Group in Omaha.

“It’s important to remember the market’s not totally falling apart here. It clearly is top-heavy with tech, but there are other groups that are actually doing pretty well under the surface,” he added.

Investor attention also turned to Anthropic, whose IPO was expected to be priced after the market closed on Wednesday. At the top of its US$70 to US$78 price range, the offering would raise about US$64.4 billion and value the company at approximately US$1.4 trillion.

Elsewhere, Target shares rose following the discount retailer’s upbeat holiday outlook, while TJX surged after forecasting stronger annual sales on expectations of robust demand ahead of the holiday shopping season.

Take-Two Interactive shares also advanced ahead of the rollout of its Grand Theft Auto VI video game.

The Fed’s October meeting minutes showed policymakers remained concerned about inflation risks and saw a need for further rate increases if the economy developed as expected.

A few policymakers argued for a 50-basis-point increase if incoming inflation data proved unfavourable. Consumer and producer price figures released after the meeting subsequently showed stronger-than-expected price growth.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller adopted a hawkish stance on Wednesday, saying the central bank needed to respond more aggressively to inflation. His remarks followed comments by New York Fed President John Williams on Tuesday that he favoured tighter monetary policy but saw no need for “dramatic action”.

Financial markets were pricing in an almost certain probability of a 25-basis-point rate increase at the conclusion of the Fed’s December meeting, according to CME’s FedWatch tool.

Detrick said inflation remained stubbornly high and expected a 25-basis-point increase in December, adding that further hikes early next year were also possible.

Meanwhile, US housing data showed mortgage rates rising, building permits weakening and pending home sales falling to a record low.

Reuters

data.title: FBM KLCI Falls 8.42 Points To 1,566.73 As Banking, Plantation Stocks Weigh
data.description:
Bursa Malaysia extended its losing streak for a second consecutive session on Nov 18, with the benchmark index shedding 8.42 points or 0.53% to 1,566.73, dragged down by selling pressure in banking and plantation heavyweights despite gains in technology stocks.

The FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) closed at 1,566.73 against the 1,575.15 on Nov 17, after moving between an intraday high of 1,575.23 and a low of 1,564.71.

Among index heavyweights, Maybank slipped five sen to RM9.92, Public Bank declined six sen to RM4.50, while SD Guthrie fell 11 sen to RM5.97.

The broader market showed mixed performance, with the FBM 70 climbing 149.01 points or 0.91% to 16,554.41, while the FBM Emas eased 8.34 points or 0.07% to 11,604.21.

The FBM Shariah gained 19.98 points or 0.17% to 11,556.61, while the F4GBM slipped 1.07 points or 0.11% to 940.28.

Among the most actively traded counters, Zetrix AI Bhd led turnover with 261.94 million shares traded, easing half a sen to 5.5 sen.

MYDCD Bhd surged 13 sen to 58 sen on 117.34 million shares, while MMAG Holdings Bhd remained unchanged at two sen with 94.70 million shares changing hands.

YTL Power International Bhd declined five sen to RM4 on 44.73 million shares, while MAG Holdings Bhd was flat at 16 sen with 44.29 million shares traded.

Despite weakness in the benchmark index, market breadth remained positive, with 630 gainers outnumbering 430 losers, while 476 counters were unchanged, 1,247 untraded and 14 suspended.

Total market turnover eased to 3.06 billion units from Nov 17’s 3.35 billion units, although trading value increased to RM2.76 billion from RM2.28 billion.

data.title: Tech Stocks Lead Bursa Malaysia Gainers As Nestle, Plantation Heavyweights Drag
data.description:
Technology and semiconductor-related stocks dominated Bursa Malaysia’s top gainers on Nov 18, led by Malaysian Pacific Industries Bhd (MPI), while Nestle (M) Bhd and plantation heavyweights topped the losers’ list despite positive broader market sentiment.

MPI emerged as the biggest gainer, jumping 70 sen to RM36.40, followed by Kelington Group Bhd and Mi Technovation Bhd, which both climbed 34 sen to RM7.14 and RM5.78, respectively.

UWC Bhd advanced 28 sen to RM5.86, while TMK Chemical Bhd gained 21 sen to RM3.11, rounding out the top five gainers.

On the losing front, Nestle suffered the steepest decline, shedding 96 sen to RM94.30, followed by Kuala Lumpur Kepong Bhd, which fell 32 sen to RM20.80.

Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Bhd dropped 21 sen to RM6.65, while Batu Kawan Bhd and Carlsberg Brewery Malaysia Bhd each declined 18 sen to RM19 and RM12.70, respectively.

Despite the mixed performance among heavyweights, market breadth remained positive, with 630 gainers outnumbering 430 losers. Another 476 counters were unchanged, 1,247 untraded and 14 suspended.

Total trading volume eased to 3.06 billion units from Nov 17’s 3.35 billion units, although transaction value rose to RM2.76 billion from RM2.28 billion, indicating stronger trading value despite lower overall volume.

data.title: Asia Stocks Edge Higher After Nvidia Earnings, With AI Concerns Still In Focus
data.description:
Asian stocks edged higher on Wednesday as investors weighed Nvidia’s stronger-than-expected sales forecast against lingering uncertainty over the artificial intelligence sector and the upcoming pricing of Anthropic’s initial public offering (IPO).

MSCI’s broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan rose 0.1%, narrowly on track to snap a four-day losing streak, while Japan’s Nikkei 225 gained 0.3% in choppy trading.

US S&P 500 E-mini futures were also up 0.2%, although Wall Street had closed lower overnight, with the benchmark S&P 500 falling 1% for its fourth consecutive daily decline.

Nvidia shares initially climbed in after-hours trading after the chipmaker reported third-quarter revenue and issued a fourth-quarter sales forecast above market expectations. However, the gains narrowed to 0.3% as investors assessed questions surrounding the company’s leadership following the abrupt departure of chief executive Jensen Huang earlier this month.

Charu Chanana, chief investment strategist at Saxo Bank in Singapore, said Nvidia’s results reassured investors but did not resolve wider concerns over returns on AI spending, financing sustainability and leadership uncertainty.

The next major test for investor appetite towards AI companies is expected to come from Anthropic, which is scheduled to price its shares on Wednesday ahead of its market debut. The company could be valued at up to US$1.4 trillion.

Jake Behan, head of capital markets at Direxion, described the week’s developments as a referendum on AI investment, with Nvidia providing an indication of demand for infrastructure and Anthropic offering insight into appetite for the next generation of AI companies.

In currency markets, the US dollar index rose 0.1% to 103.70, after reaching its highest level since April 2, 2025, on Tuesday. The yen traded largely unchanged at 159.30 against the US dollar.

Japan’s exports rose for a 14th consecutive month in October, supported by demand for semiconductor-related shipments.

Meanwhile, Brent crude futures fell 1.1% to US$92.16 a barrel after data showed an increase in US crude and fuel inventories last week. However, ongoing conflict in the Middle East and shipping disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz limited the decline.

Bitcoin rose 0.5% to US$64,605.55, while Ether gained 0.3% to US$1,809.98.

Reuters

data.title: Gold Regains Lustre After Rebounding To US$3,864, Bearish Outlook Unchanged
data.description:
RHB Investment Bank has maintained its bearish trading outlook on COMEX Gold futures despite the precious metal staging a modest rebound on Tuesday, cautioning that weak buying momentum could lead to further downside towards US$3,800.

Gold futures gained US$11.20 to close at US$3,864.20 per ounce, after opening at US$3,859.50 and fluctuating between an intraday high of US$3,894 and a low of US$3,839.20.

RHB said the latest bullish candlestick formation suggests that selling pressure has tapered off, although the broader technical outlook remains bearish.

The Relative Strength Index (RSI) continues to trend below the neutral 50-point mark, indicating that buying momentum remains weak.

The research house believes that as long as gold remains below the US$4,100 resistance level, the commodity could resume its downward trajectory and retest the immediate support of US$3,800.

A decisive breach below this level could expose gold to further losses towards US$3,600.

RHB Maintains Short Position

Given the prevailing bearish technical setup, RHB recommends traders maintain the short position initiated on November 12 at US$3,885.30, with a stop-loss threshold set at US$4,100 to manage trading risks.

The research house identified immediate support at US$3,800, followed by US$3,600, while resistance levels are pegged at US$4,000 and US$4,100, respectively.

Despite the latest recovery, RHB believes the bears retain the technical advantage, with insufficient buying momentum to signal a convincing trend reversal.

data.title: Micron Technology Eyes Technical Rebound, Eyes US$830 Upside Target: RHB
data.description:
Micron Technology Inc is showing signs of a potential countertrend rebound after bouncing off a key support level, according to RHB Investment Bank’s latest technical analysis.

The research house noted that the semiconductor stock had formed a candlestick with a long lower shadow, indicating strong buying interest near the US$675 support level.

A decisive breakout above the immediate resistance of US$730 could pave the way for further gains towards US$770, followed by the higher resistance level of US$830.

The technical formation suggests that buying momentum could be returning following the stock’s recent downside correction.

However, RHB cautioned that a fall below the US$675 support level would invalidate the potential rebound and trigger a resumption of the bearish trend.

Investors should closely monitor the US$730 resistance level for confirmation of a bullish breakout, while the US$675 threshold remains critical in determining the stock’s near-term direction.

data.title: Stock Today: MR DIY Falls 1.92% After 3Q Profit Decline
data.description:
Shares in MR D.I.Y. Group (M) Bhd fell 2 sen or 1.92% to RM1.02 at 3.06pm on Wednesday, extending losses after the retailer reported a year-on-year decline in third-quarter earnings.

The stock opened at RM1.05 and traded between RM0.985 and RM1.07, compared with its last adjusted closing price of RM1.04. Trading volume stood at 14.59 million shares.

MR DIY reported a 6.4% year-on-year decline in profit after tax to RM127.3 million for the third quarter ended Sept 30, 2026, despite revenue rising 4.8% to RM1.26 billion.

The group attributed the weaker profitability to changes in product mix and continued investments in its retail network, customer engagement and operations.

For the first nine months of FY2026, revenue increased 5.9% to RM3.89 billion, while profit after tax fell 3.2% to RM453.8 million as higher operating expenses outpaced revenue growth.

The group also declared an interim dividend of RM123 million, equivalent to about 97% of its third-quarter profit after tax.

data.title: Stock Today: MyDCD Rises 7.78% After Weak ACE Market Debut
data.description:
MyDCD Bhd shares rebounded 7.78% to RM0.485 at 11.58am, recovering some ground after opening 14.29% below its initial public offering (IPO) price on its ACE Market debut a day earlier.

The stock, which was last traded at RM0.485, gained 3.5 sen from its last traded price of RM0.45 on Tuesday, with 328.20 million shares changing hands.

It traded between RM0.45 and RM0.485 during the session, opening at RM0.465 and reaching an intraday high of RM0.485.

Despite Wednesday’s recovery, MyDCD remained 7.5 sen or 13.39% below its IPO price of RM0.56.

The data centre infrastructure services provider had made its Bursa Malaysia debut on Tuesday at RM0.48, down 8 sen from its IPO price, before trading between RM0.48 and RM0.51.

MyDCD raised RM268.8 million through its IPO, which attracted strong demand from the Malaysian public tranche, with an oversubscription rate of 36.46 times.

The group recorded revenue of RM666.03 million and profit after tax of RM66.8 million for the financial year ended June 30, 2026.

It also reported an outstanding order book of RM1.32 billion as at September 30, comprising mainly data centre mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection integration projects.

data.title: US Dollar Holds Near 19-Month High On Rate Hike Expectations
data.description:
The US dollar held near a 19-month high on Wednesday after stronger-than-expected import price growth and comments from Federal Reserve officials reinforced expectations of another interest rate hike in December.

The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, edged up 0.05% to 103.66 after touching 103.78 overnight, its highest level since April 2, 2025.

The euro slipped 0.12% to US$1.0984, while the yen weakened 0.06% to 159.46 per dollar. Sterling also lost 0.06% to US$1.32.

Investors are increasingly convinced that the Fed will raise rates next month to contain inflation, with traders pricing in a 25-basis-point increase, according to the CME FedWatch tool.

US retail sales rose 0.2% in October, matching expectations, while import prices climbed 1.1%, exceeding forecasts for a 0.7% increase.

ANZ economist Henry Russell said the retail sales data reinforced the case for further rate increases, citing strong domestic demand that could sustain inflationary pressures.

New York Fed President John Williams said on Tuesday that the central bank would likely need to raise rates again to address persistent inflation. Investors are also watching for comments from other Fed officials and the release of minutes from the central bank’s previous meeting on Thursday.

Elsewhere, the yen weakened despite Japanese exports rising for a 14th consecutive month in October, with shipments increasing 20.5% year-on-year to a record monthly value, supported by semiconductor demand.

The Australian dollar remained near a 10-month low at US$0.673, while the New Zealand dollar gained 0.05% to US$0.5495.

Meanwhile, Asian technology shares received a boost after Nvidia reported that its third-quarter revenue had doubled and forecast fourth-quarter sales above market expectations, easing concerns over the recent selloff in AI-related stocks.

Bitcoin rose 0.55% to US$64,660.70, while ether gained 0.63% to US$1,816.60.

Reuters

data.title: Crypto Market Remains Under Pressure Though Bitcoin, Ethereum Rebound
data.description:
Bitcoin and Ethereum edged higher on Nov 18, showing tentative signs of stabilisation after a prolonged cryptocurrency sell-off, although weak institutional demand and broader risk aversion continued to weigh on sentiment.

Bitcoin gained 0.55% to US$64,660.70, while Ethereum rose 0.63% to US$1,816.60 in early Asian trading.

Despite the modest rebound, both cryptocurrencies remained under significant pressure following sharp losses in recent sessions, with Bitcoin struggling to regain momentum above US$65,000.

Institutional outflows continued to undermine confidence, with US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds recording US$1.07 billion in net withdrawals last week, extending a seven-session redemption streak.

Meanwhile, a stronger US dollar, elevated bond yields and concerns over tighter monetary policy continued to dampen appetite for riskier assets, limiting prospects for a sustained cryptocurrency recovery.

Investors are now watching whether Bitcoin can reclaim US$65,000 and Ethereum can sustain its recovery above US$1,800, with further volatility expected as markets assess the outlook for US interest rates.

data.title: Stock Today: YTL Power Rebounds 1.23% As Investors Weigh AI Data Centre Concerns
data.description:
YTL Power International Bhd shares edged higher on Wednesday, recovering some ground after recent selling pressure linked to concerns over potential US restrictions on advanced AI chip access through overseas data centres.

As at 10.27am, the utility counter rose five sen or 1.23% to RM4.10, from its last traded price of RM4.05. The stock opened at RM4.10, touched an intraday high of RM4.13 and a low of RM3.96, with 6.54 million shares traded.

At the time of writing, buying interest stood at 149,500 shares at RM4.10, while selling pressure amounted to 48,800 shares at RM4.11.

The rebound comes after MBSB Research described the recent sell-off as excessive, maintaining its BUY recommendation on YTL Power with an unchanged target price of RM5.98.

The research house said investors should distinguish allegations involving NVIDIA and Singapore-based Megaspeed International from YTL Power’s own data centre operations. It added that a formal clarification from the company could help address investor concerns.

MBSB Research also noted that YTL Power’s principal data centre business operates largely on a colocation model, providing space, power and cooling infrastructure to third-party tenants rather than directly operating their GPU computing systems.

The proposed US restrictions could introduce uncertainty for operators with significant exposure to Chinese customers, although MBSB Research cautioned against viewing the measures as a blanket restriction on Malaysia’s data centre industry.

data.title: Ringgit Edges Up With Investors Looking To GDP For Fresh Direction
data.description:
The ringgit opened marginally higher against the US dollar on Wednesday as investors awaited Malaysia’s third-quarter 2026 gross domestic product (GDP) figures, due at noon, for further direction on the local currency.

At 8am, the ringgit stood at 4.0910/0965 against the greenback, compared with Tuesday’s closing rate of 4.0915/0960.

Bank Muamalat Malaysia Bhd chief economist Dr Mohd Afzanizam Abdul Rashid said market attention would be focused on the GDP announcement, with stronger-than-expected growth potentially lending support to the ringgit.

He said the US Dollar Index remained elevated at 103.550 points as markets assessed the Federal Reserve’s hawkish stance ahead of its December policy meeting.

“Concerns over restrictions on ownership of US-made microchips in the technology sector are also expected to shape market sentiment. Hence, the ringgit is expected to trade within a narrow range today,” he told Bernama.

Against other major currencies, the ringgit strengthened to 2.5647/5683 against the Japanese yen from 2.5736/5766 at Tuesday’s close and edged higher to 4.4968/5029 against the euro from 4.5007/5056.

However, it weakened against the British pound to 5.4018/4090 from 5.3991/4051.

Against regional currencies, the ringgit gained against the Singapore dollar at 3.1745/1793 from 3.1759/1796 and the Thai baht at 12.0892/1166 from 12.1014/1201.

It was flat against the Indonesian rupiah at 224.1/224.4 and the Philippine peso at 6.42/6.43.

data.title: FBM KLCI Sinks To 15-Month Low Despite Nvidia Earnings Boost
data.description:
Bursa Malaysia remained under pressure on Wednesday, with the FBM KLCI falling to a 15-month low as weak sentiment on Wall Street and concerns over new US semiconductor export controls offset optimism from Nvidia’s stronger-than-expected earnings.

The benchmark index slipped 6.08 points to 1,569.07 at 9.03am, failing to stage a rebound after Tuesday’s sharp correction.

The decline came despite Nvidia shares gaining about 2% in after-hours trading after the chipmaker delivered results that beat analyst expectations. US index futures also advanced, with Nasdaq mini futures up about 1.3% at the time of writing.

Apex Securities said sporadic bargain-hunting could emerge following the previous session’s steep losses, but a sustained recovery would depend on improving market breadth and greater clarity over the implementation of the new US chip restrictions.

The research house said technology stocks could attempt a relief rebound following Nvidia’s earnings, although gains were likely to remain selective given the export controls affecting the semiconductor sector.

It added that persistent pessimism surrounding artificial intelligence could prolong weakness in construction, utilities and industrial products stocks.

Meanwhile, high-dividend-yielding counters and domestically oriented large-cap stocks could attract interest as valuations become more attractive following the recent market correction.

Investors are also awaiting Malaysia’s third-quarter gross domestic product figures, scheduled for release at noon, with growth expected to moderate to 5.3% from the previous quarter.

Among the key index-linked banking stocks, Maybank fell six sen to RM9.91, AmBank shed nine sen to RM6.51, CIMB lost two sen to RM7.02 while Public Bank slipped two sen to RM4.54.

On the broader market, Zetrix AI declined half a sen to 5.5 sen, MMAG was unchanged at two sen while MyDCD gained 1.5 sen to 46.5 sen.

data.title: Kospi Rebounds 2.6% As Nvidia Earnings Revive South Korean Chip Stocks
data.description:
South Korean stocks staged a sharp rebound at Wednesday’s open, with the benchmark Kospi climbing 2.62% as bargain hunters returned following four consecutive sessions of losses and Nvidia’s upbeat earnings outlook lifted sentiment towards chipmakers.

The Kospi gained 130.34 points to 5,098.82 at the opening bell, recovering above the psychologically important 5,000-point mark after slipping below that level on Tuesday for the first time in about nine months.

The index had come under pressure from sustained foreign selling of technology shares, triggering four straight sessions of declines.

Investor sentiment improved after Nvidia shares rose 2% in after-hours trading following a revenue forecast that exceeded market expectations. The results marked the chipmaker’s first earnings report since Jensen Huang’s departure as chief executive.

The rebound came despite a weaker session on Wall Street overnight, where the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 1.64%, the S&P 500 declined 1.03% and the Nasdaq Composite lost 0.74%.

Investors are also keeping an eye on artificial intelligence company Anthropic’s market debut, scheduled for Thursday.

data.title: HSIF Gives Up Previous Gains, RHB Keeps 24,500-Point Stop-Loss

The index gained 20 points in evening trading to last trade at 23,510 points.

RHB Research said the bearish candlestick had erased the previous session’s gains, while the index remained below both its 20-day and 50-day SMA lines. The relative strength index (RSI) also stayed below the 50% level, indicating that selling momentum remained dominant.

The research house expects the HSIF to retest immediate support at 23,000 points, followed by the next support at 22,500 points. Resistance is pegged at 24,000 points and 24,500 points.

RHB Research said its negative trading bias remains intact as long as the index stays below the stop-loss threshold.
